title: Are Nike shoes waterproof?
question: Are Nike shoes waterproof?
answer: Most Nike lifestyle and running shoes are not fully waterproof, though select trail and winter styles feature water-resistant uppers.

title: Which shoes are best for marathon running?
question: Which shoes are best for marathon running?
answer: Racing-focused models with max cushioning and lightweight construction, such as carbon-plated racing flats, are best suited for marathons.

title: How do I clean white sneakers?
question: How do I clean white sneakers?
answer: Use a soft brush with mild soap and water, avoid harsh chemicals, and air dry away from direct heat.

title: Which shoes have the most cushioning?
question: Which shoes have the most cushioning?
answer: Models labeled with "Max" cushioning ratings offer the highest level of impact absorption, ideal for long-distance comfort.

title: Which shoes are suitable for trail running?
question: Which shoes are suitable for trail running?
answer: Trail running shoes feature aggressive outsole traction and reinforced uppers designed for off-road terrain.

title: What's the difference between a trainer and a racing flat?
question: What's the difference between a trainer and a racing flat?
answer: Trainers offer more cushioning and durability for daily use, while racing flats are lighter and built for speed on race day.

title: Are Adidas Boost midsoles better than standard EVA foam?
question: Are Adidas Boost midsoles better than standard EVA foam?
answer: Boost midsoles offer more energy return and cushioning compared to standard EVA foam, though EVA is lighter and more affordable.

title: Which shoes are good for people with flat feet?
question: Which shoes are good for people with flat feet?
answer: Stability shoes with motion control and firm arch support are generally recommended for flat feet.

title: Do all running shoes have the same heel-to-toe drop?
question: Do all running shoes have the same heel-to-toe drop?
answer: No, heel drop varies by model, typically ranging from 0mm to 12mm depending on the shoe's design purpose.

title: What does "neutral" vs "stability" shoe mean?
question: What does "neutral" vs "stability" shoe mean?
answer: Neutral shoes suit runners with a normal gait, while stability shoes provide extra support for runners who overpronate.

title: Are basketball shoes good for everyday wear?
question: Are basketball shoes good for everyday wear?
answer: Yes, many basketball shoes are popular as lifestyle sneakers due to their cushioning and durable construction.

title: What is the difference between mesh and knit uppers?
question: What is the difference between mesh and knit uppers?
answer: Mesh uppers are typically more breathable and rigid, while knit uppers offer a more flexible, sock-like fit.

title: Which shoes are best for wide feet?
question: Which shoes are best for wide feet?
answer: Look for models offered in "Wide" or "Extra Wide" width options, which provide extra room in the toe box.

title: Do trail shoes work for road running?
question: Do trail shoes work for road running?
answer: Trail shoes can be used on roads but their aggressive tread may wear faster and feel less cushioned than dedicated road shoes.

title: What is a carbon plate in running shoes?
question: What is a carbon plate in running shoes?
answer: A carbon plate is a rigid insert in the midsole that increases propulsion and energy return, common in racing shoes.

title: Are soccer cleats different from turf shoes?
question: Are soccer cleats different from turf shoes?
answer: Yes, cleats have molded or removable studs for grass, while turf shoes have small rubber nubs designed for artificial turf.

title: What shoes are best for weightlifting?
question: What shoes are best for weightlifting?
answer: Flat, stable shoes with minimal cushioning and a low heel-to-toe drop provide the best base for lifting.

title: How do I know which shoes are true to size?
question: How do I know which shoes are true to size?
answer: Product pages include specific sizing notes; check the Size & Fit tab for brand and model-specific guidance.

title: Are all Adidas Originals shoes lifestyle only?
question: Are all Adidas Originals shoes lifestyle only?
answer: Most Originals models are designed for casual wear, though some, like Samba, were originally performance shoes.

title: What is the benefit of a lower stack height?
question: What is the benefit of a lower stack height?
answer: Lower stack heights offer more ground feel and stability but less cushioning than higher stack shoes.

title: Which shoes are recommended for standing all day at work?
question: Which shoes are recommended for standing all day at work?
answer: Shoes with high cushioning and good arch support are best for all-day standing comfort.

title: Do skate shoes offer good ankle support?
question: Do skate shoes offer good ankle support?
answer: Skate shoes prioritize board feel and durability over ankle support; high-top styles offer more coverage.

title: What makes a shoe "breathable"?
question: What makes a shoe "breathable"?
answer: Breathable shoes use mesh or knit materials that allow airflow to keep feet cool and reduce moisture buildup.

title: Are there vegan shoe options available?
question: Are there vegan shoe options available?
answer: Yes, select models use synthetic materials instead of leather and are labeled as vegan-friendly.

title: Which shoes work best in hot weather?
question: Which shoes work best in hot weather?
answer: Lightweight, highly breathable shoes with mesh uppers are best suited for hot weather conditions.
